Convert a LinkMap to igraph

as.igraph.LinkMap.Rd

Extract relational information from LinkMap and return an igraph object. Calls igraph::graph_from_biadjacency_matrix under the hood.

Usage

# S3 method for class '`MultiFactor::LinkMap`'
as.igraph(x, directed = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

x

a MultiFactor

directed

See ?igraph::graph_from_biadjacency_matrix

...

Additional arguments passed to igraph::graph_from_biadjacency_matrix.

Value

an igraph object.

Details

If a LinkMap contains metadata, this can be found back as edge attributes in the returned graph (see igraph::edge_attr())

Examples

x <- randomLinkMap()

# Make igraph object:
igraph::as.igraph(x)
#> IGRAPH 71dc4ab UN-B 52 338 -- 
#> + attr: type (v/l), name (v/c)
#> + edges from 71dc4ab (vertex names):
#>   [1] d--A e--A f--A g--A h--A j--A k--A l--A m--A n--A p--A q--A r--A s--A t--A

#>  [31] r--B s--B t--B v--B w--B y--B z--B c--C d--C e--C f--C h--C i--C k--C o--C
#>  [46] q--C s--C u--C v--C z--C a--D b--D d--D e--D i--D k--D m--D n--D q--D r--D
